non_claims: Chain length and any double bond are assigned by the precursor composition hypothesis, not by the ions.
Sulfoxide configuration, glucose versus another hexose and oxime geometry are not resolved.

notes: Loss of CH3SOH from [M-H]- is reported for methylsulfinylalkyl glucosinolates in ten papers and is the base or main MS2 ion in six (four with standards); it is weak (3 %) for glucoraphenin.

competitors.note: Methylthioalkyl, methylsulfonylalkyl and the isobaric 2-phenylethyl glucosinolate lack the CH3SOH loss (Lee 2008 Table 2; Bialecki 2010 p. 281; Hooshmand 2021 Table 4).

priors.note: In negative-mode direct infusion of the standards only the deprotonated glucosinolate ions were seen, with no adduct or degradation ions.
The deprotonated sulfate [M-H]- is the predominant glucosinolate ion in negative ESI.
